The COVID block returned **77,808** records, the broad outcomes block **4,935,217**, and the combined strategy **13,793**. Counts were run on 2026-09-28 with the required Entrez-date cutoff through 2020-11-22; no publication-date limit was used. Individual line counts are in the audit.

Relative recall was **11/11 (100%)** on the development set and **4/4 (100%)** on the held-out set. These 15 records came from discovery and cited-reference screening; the held-out set is small and semi-independent, so these figures do not establish absolute sensitivity. One verified MeSH heading, `Psychological Well-Being[Mesh]`, returned zero records under the cutoff and is documented in the audit as a retained OR alternative.

This is a draft strategy and needs PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use.
